title: Industry 4.0
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Industry 4.0 - Transforming the Future Beyond Manufacturing - Volume 2, Human-Centred, Organizational and Societal Transformations explores the human, organizational, territorial, and societal dimensions of digital transformation. Bringing together contributions on workforce change, organizational resilience, SMEs, higher education, skills development, public infrastructure, smart cities, cultural sustainability, data governance, privacy, and ethical digital services, the volume shows how Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0 reshape not only production systems but also the ways people work, learn, collaborate, and govern. By linking human-centred digitalization, social innovation, sustainability, and responsible data practices, it offers a broader view of digital transformation as a socio-technical process and a valuable reference for researchers, educators, policymakers, and practitioners seeking more resilient, inclusive, and socially responsible pathways of innovation.
